contexts.text: Frontlets between the eyes () = the understanding.
The lintel and the posts have a similar signification to the frontlet and the hands.
And for frontlets between the eyes () = that it must be perpetually in the understanding. (Compare AC 8067.)

For frontlets () = for a sign of love to Jehovah God. It is said between the eyes. because the eyes = the intelligence and wisdom which are from that love; and the wisdom from that love is to have God continually before the eyes.

Its being said for frontlets before the eyes, was a representative that the Lord looks at Angels and men in the forehead, because from Divine love; and gives to Angels and men to look at Him from intelligence and wisdom; for the eyes = the understanding; for all man's understanding is from his good of love.
